title: TFE Capacity Test Scenario
description: Authoritative format for a TFE capacity/saturation test scenario. A scenario is defined entirely by this file plus secrets supplied via environment variables; no code changes are needed to define or vary a test.

duration.description: A k6-style duration: digits with an optional s/m/h suffix (bare = seconds). Examples: "30", "90s", "15m", "1h".

name.description: Human-readable scenario name, recorded in results.

id_prefix.description: Informational label for the test family.

organization.description: Existing TFE organization the test workspaces are created in.

tls_skip_verify.description: Last-resort TLS bypass. Prefer SSL_CERT_FILE with your private CA.

token_env.description: Name of the env var holding the TFE API token (must be able to force-delete workspaces). The token is never stored in this file.

admin_token_env.description: Optional env var holding a site-admin token; enables the observer's cluster-wide queue-depth sampling.

token_env.description: Env var holding the Artifactory bearer token for the tarball download.

tarball_url.description: Artifactory URL of the prebuilt Terraform config slug (.tar.gz).

tarball_sha256.description: Optional expected sha256 of the tarball; the wrapper fails if the download doesn't match.

terraform_version.description: Terraform version to pin on the workspace (must exist in the air-gapped TFE).

auto_apply.description: Exercise apply automatically after a successful plan.

run_variables.description: Optional Terraform variables passed per run, so a scenario can tune the workload (e.g. mock_count, hold_seconds) without rebuilding the tarball. Keys/values are strings. NOTE: using these means the tarball sha256 no longer fully identifies the workload — record them (they are captured in summary.json).

name_template.description: Workspace name template. MUST contain {test_id} (for cleanup/guard); {vu} and {seq} make each ephemeral workspace unique. Only letters, numbers, - and _ are allowed in the final name.

execution_mode.description: Runs execute in TFE agent pods.

delete_after_run.description: Force-delete each ephemeral workspace after its run.

concurrency.description: The ladder: target execution concurrency (= k6 VUs) per stage. Include the config ceiling (TFE_CAPACITY_CONCURRENCY x replicas). The first entry is the warmup/baseline when warmup_stage is true.

return_to_baseline.description: Optional concurrency to re-run after the ladder, to detect drift against the same-concurrency ladder stage.

warmup_stage.description: Treat the first stage as warmup and exclude it from the knee calculation.

graceful_stop.description: k6 gracefulStop per stage. Set >= one full run lifecycle so in-flight runs finish and delete their workspace instead of being cut off.

min_completions_per_stage.description: A stage with fewer measured completions is flagged as not having reached steady state.

run_interval.description: How often each VU polls its run by ID.

observer_interval.description: How often the observer samples cluster-wide queue depth.

run_deadline_factor.description: Per-run watchdog: a run is force-timed-out after factor x expected_run_duration.

expected_run_duration.description: Expected single-run duration; sets the watchdog deadline. Calibrate in an N=1 pilot.

failure_rate.description: k6 abortOnFail: stop the stage if the run failure rate exceeds this.

any_429.description: Abort the stage on any HTTP 429 (rate-limited => results invalid).

throughput_gain_floor_pct.description: Knee if added concurrency yields less than this % more completion throughput.

p95_run_duration_rise_pct.description: Knee if p95 run duration rises more than this % over the baseline.

queue_never_drains.description: Treat a queue that never drains within a dwell (below the ceiling) as saturation.

failure_rate_pct.description: Knee if the per-stage failure rate exceeds this %.

stop_on_knee.description: If true, the wrapper halts the ladder once the knee is confirmed (one stage past it).

tfe_capacity_concurrency.description: The TFE_CAPACITY_CONCURRENCY value in effect during the test (per pod).

terraform_enterprise_replicas.description: Number of terraform-enterprise pods. ceiling = concurrency x replicas.
